character.description: small top-down mint and silver space exploration ship, nose up; only the engine flame at the bottom changes

burn.action: engine exhaust flame flickers: the flame at the bottom of the ship grows and shrinks and changes shape slightly each frame; the ship body, size and position stay identical in every frame

style: crisp hand-painted HD 2D game sprite, soft cel shading; same ship in every frame; flame in warm white-yellow-orange
